contract.specification: Write range_within_u64(start: int, length: int, limit: int) -> bool. Inputs are integers. Return False if any input is outside unsigned 64-bit range 0..18446744073709551615. Otherwise return whether the half-open range [start, start+length) fits within [0, limit). An empty range at start==limit is valid. Reject start>limit even for an empty range. Use the overflow-safe comparison length <= limit - start after checking start <= limit. Use only integer/bool literals, comparisons, boolean operators, subtraction, if and return.

provenance.teacher_opinion: No defect found. The implementation correctly validates inputs against the u64 range, rejects `start > limit` (including empty ranges), and uses the overflow-safe comparison `length <= limit - start` after confirming `start <= limit`. The special case `start == limit and length == 0` is handled, though logically subsumed by the general check. All constraints (integer/bool literals, comparisons, boolean operators, subtraction, if/return) are satisfied. The host verifier passed 2926 cases within the stated Python fixture scope.
